effective_for: Task 23 human rounds started after this rule was recorded

positive_case.question_6: YES when extra detail was introduced and is structurally useful; N-A is allowed only when the candidate introduced no extra detail relevant to the target.
positive_case.n_a_policy: N-A is allowed only when the target/style contract makes that criterion genuinely inapplicable. A criterion explicitly required by the target contract cannot be converted to N-A.
positive_case.pass_condition: Every applicable core question is YES, with no NO or UNCERTAIN on a required criterion. Question 6 follows its separate applicability rule.

negative_controls.condition: A negative control is correctly rejected when it does not satisfy the positive-case pass condition and the manipulated failure remains visible in at least one corresponding required criterion.
negative_controls.texture_only_note: A YES on question 1 by itself is not sufficient evidence of major-form refinement; low-frequency evidence must independently show that large-form modelling survives suppression of small texture/noise.

stylized_flat_control.condition: Do not apply representational-realism criteria that the explicit flat/graphic style contract makes inapplicable. N-A is valid for those criteria and must not be treated as failure or as a demand for photoreal refinement.
